items.source: The email address that will be used for user authentication to the registry.
items.translation: 用于向注册表进行用户身份验证的电子邮件地址。

items.source: The password that will be used for user authentication to the registry.
items.translation: 用于用户向注册表进行身份验证的密码。

items.source: The token that will be used for token authentication to the registry.
items.translation: 用于对注册表进行令牌身份验证的令牌。

items.source: The username that will be used for user authentication to the registry.
items.translation: 用于对注册表进行用户身份验证的用户名。

items.source: Encapsulates Docker registry authentication configuration options.
items.translation: 封装 Docker 注册表身份验证配置选项。
